privacy

we don't sell your faith. that's the whole policy; the rest is how.

what "we don't sell your faith" means

which door you walk, what you listen to, how often you sit, what you ask the Guide — none of it is sold, shared, rented or traded to anyone, ever. not to advertisers, not to data brokers, not to religious institutions, not to your Keeper. this will be written into the legal policy with those words, and it can't be changed without telling you first.

the guide and the companion

when you ask the guide or talk with the companion, your words go to our server and to claude (made by anthropic) to be answered. they're never logged and never sold. your journal stays on your phone unless you tap share.

ads

no ads in the pilot. if ads ever come to the free house: between sessions, never during, never targeted by your door.

what we keep

as little as we can. there are no accounts in the pilot: your days, your answers, your journal and your book stay on your phone. if you turn on reminders, your reminder time and time zone go to our server so the reminder can reach you. anonymous return counts (which day someone came back, never who) are on unless you switch them off under You › Your data. the optional wellbeing check-in sends only a score and a day bucket, never a name. no location. no contacts. no microphone unless you tap "say it back," and what you say isn't stored.

friends

if you walk with a friend (the invite rides on a lantern link), a small anonymous friend id goes to our server: no email, no account. friends see your nickname, your streak, whether today's lesson is done, and your weekly light if you both join the weekly board. never your door, your answers, your journal or anything you wrote. no strangers, no public ranks. leave friends any time and it's deleted. a circle works the same way: a code, an anonymous id, counts and nicknames only — never your lessons, answers, journal or Guide questions. the leader sees the same as everyone else.

your side of the table

forget everything clears what the companion knows about you. export everything or delete everything from settings, any time, and it's gone — not "deactivated."

this is the plain-English version. the legal version is being written by an actual lawyer and will be here before launch. where the two differ, the legal one wins — and we'll fix this one.
